name: mocapless-mcp

tools.name: account
tools.description: Who is signed in and how many credits are left. One credit is roughly one second of animation.

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: The characters in the account, newest first. New accounts have a demo mannequin ready to animate.

tools.name: upload_character
tools.description: Upload a character and wait until its skeleton has been read (seconds for a normal file, a minute or two for a very heavy one). Returns the character id to animate.

path.description: Local path to an FBX, GLB, GLTF or DAE. Rigged or not - an un-rigged character gets a skeleton built for it.
path.title: Path

tools.name: create_animal
tools.description: No model yet: have a textured 3D animal made from a description and rigged. Costs about 30 credits; refunded if it fails.

description.description: The animal in a few words: 'a brown horse', 'a grey wolf', 'a golden retriever'.
description.title: Description

wait.description: Wait until it is ready (about five minutes). If false, returns at once; check list_characters.
wait.title: Wait

tools.name: plan_motion
tools.description: Free preview of what generate_animation would do for this prompt: the beats, the engine, the price in credits and the current balance. Nothing is generated or charged.

prompt.description: What the character should do, in plain English. Sequences are fine: 'trots forward, then sits down'.
prompt.title: Prompt

character_id.description: The character the plan is for; an animal and a person have different moves. Omit for the most recent one.
character_id.title: Character Id

tools.name: generate_animation
tools.description: Generate an animation from a sentence on the user's character, wait for it, and download the files. Charges credits (see plan_motion first if the price matters); a failed job is refunded automatically.

prompt.description: What the character should do, in plain English, in order. Best as one to four short present-tense beats about the body: 'trots forward, stops, looks around, then sits down.'
prompt.title: Prompt

character_id.description: A character id from list_characters or upload_character. Omit to use the most recent ready character.
character_id.title: Character Id

loop.description: Make the clip loop seamlessly (for idles, walks, dances).
loop.title: Loop

quality.description: 'standard' (one take) or 'best' (two takes, keeps the steadier one; same credits, a little slower).
quality.title: Quality

wait.description: Wait for the result (usually 30-90 seconds). If false, returns the job id to check with get_job.
wait.title: Wait

download_dir.description: Where to save the files. Default: ~/mocapless/<job>/ (or MOCAPLESS_DOWNLOAD_DIR).
download_dir.title: Download Dir

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a generation, and its files once it has finished.

download_dir.description: If set and the job succeeded, download the files here.
download_dir.title: Download Dir

tools.name: share_link
tools.description: A public link to watch the animation in the browser - the clip only, not the files.

tools.name: character_pack
tools.description: The full animation set of one character (idle, walk, trot, run, jump, sit, lie down and more, in one FBX and one GLB): whether it is unlocked, how each move is coming along, and the files once built.

download_dir.description: If set and the pack is ready, save its zip here.
download_dir.title: Download Dir

tools.name: unlock_character
tools.description: A checkout link (one payment per character) for the person to open: it opens every animation of the character for download and builds its full set. You cannot pay; hand over the link.

instructions: Mocapless rigs and animates 3D characters from a sentence - four-legged animals above all (a Meshy or Tripo model, rigged or not), and people. Bring the character with upload_character (a file on disk) or create_animal (from a description). plan_motion previews the beats and the price for free; generate_animation makes the clip, waits and downloads the files. Prompts work best in plain present-tense English that says what the body does, in order: 'trots forward, stops, looks around, then sits down.' Up to 30 seconds per clip. When a download is held, or credits run out, give the person the checkout link from unlock_character; never ask for card details.
